description: Story 8.2 - Profile Contact Information + Story 9.1 - Community/Marketplace Analytics: Add location and website to User model, update validation/service/mobile screens. Add analytics aggregation endpoint for Community/Marketplace with time ranges to admin.
steps: 1. Update backend/src/modules/users/user.model.js: Add location: { type: String, default: null, maxlength: 100 } and website: { type: String, default: null, maxlength: 200 } to the userSchema.

2. Update backend/src/modules/users/user.validation.js updateProfileSchema: Add location: z.string().max(100).optional().nullable() and website: z.string().max(200).optional().nullable() inside the body object (before .strict()).
3. Update backend/src/modules/users/user.service.js allowedUpdates array in updateUserProfile: Add 'location' and 'website'.
4. Update mobile/src/services/user.service.ts User interface: Add location?: string | null and website?: string | null.

5. Update mobile/src/screens/profile/EditProfileScreen.tsx: Add location and website state variables (init from profile). Add Location and Website text inputs in the form (after Bio). Include location and website in handleSave updateProfile call.

6. Update mobile/src/screens/profile/ProfileScreen.tsx: After the bio/role section and before the stats, show location and website as plain Text components (NON-CLICKABLE, no onPress, no Linking). Only show if non-null. Use Feather icons (map-pin for location, globe for website).
7. Update mobile/src/screens/profile/UserProfileScreen.tsx: In the profile info section (after bio), show location and website as plain Text (NON-CLICKABLE). Only show if non-null.

8. Story 9.1: Update backend/src/modules/community/community.controller.js - Add a new exported function getInterestAnalytics that returns: { community: { total, last7Days, last30Days }, marketplace: { total, last7Days, last30Days } } using CommunityWaitlist.countDocuments with date filters.
9. Update backend/src/modules/admin/admin.routes.js: Add route: router.get('/community-interest/analytics', getInterestAnalytics); Import getInterestAnalytics from community.controller.js.

10. Update admin/src/pages/CommunityInterest.tsx: Add an analytics summary section at the top showing the 6 counts (community total/7d/30d, marketplace total/7d/30d) fetched from the new endpoint. Display as cards or a simple grid.
acceptance_criteria: User model has location and website fields with proper constraints
EditProfileScreen has location and website inputs
ProfileScreen shows location/website as NON-CLICKABLE plain text
UserProfileScreen shows location/website as NON-CLICKABLE plain text
GET /admin/community-interest/analytics returns community/marketplace counts with time ranges
CommunityInterest admin page displays analytics summary
verification: Read all modified files and confirm proper field additions, validation, service, mobile UI (no clickable links), and analytics endpoint
